The picture depicts a young man sitting at his desk, staring at his phone screen which is playing short videos, while the morning sun rises outside the window. Below the picture are the words: "Are you watching other people's lives, or living your own?"

The implied meaning of the drawing is not difficult to understand. Nowadays, many young people spend countless hours scrolling through short videos, watching others travel, study and succeed. However, while they are watching other people's lives, their own time is quietly passing away. The contrast between the bright sunrise outside and the dim phone screen inside suggests that real life is waiting for those who look up from their screens.

In my opinion, we should reflect on how we spend our time. Watching others make progress cannot make ourselves better. Therefore, it is wise to put down the phone occasionally, set clear goals and take real action, because a life truly worth watching is the one we live ourselves.
